objective: Bring Brock's List to Thorgrum Borrelson in Thelsamar.

description: I see a lot of young dwarves at my door, eager to learn the trade of mining.  And if there's one thing a miner needs more than anything, it's a pick!
I have a list of mining students who scored high in their lessons and earned an honorary pick.  Take my list to Golnir Bouldertoe in Ironforge.  He'll get the picks ready.
The fastest way to Ironforge is on a gryphon, so bring the list to our gryphon master, Thorgrum Borrelson, and speak with him about transport to Ironforge.
progress: Have you had your fill of Thelsamar so soon? Are you ready to leave for another city?
completion: You have to get this to Ironforge, eh? For a small fee I can put you on the back of one of my gryphons, and it'll take you there. How does that sound?
